title: Blood Battle with Hua Yunfei
summary: Ye Fan spreads word that he will serve an herb gatherer as a last chance to survive, which draws everyone to the Eternal Heaven Gate in Yan Capital. After promising Nannan he'll be back soon, he accuses Hua Yunfei there of setting the Ruthless Dojo killing trap, trying to devour Ji Ziyue's physique and sending the soul clones. Hua Yunfei denies it and turns the charge back on him, then fights using Star Peak's divine techniques, the Nine-Calamity Phoenix Melody (onlookers now think he's at Dragon Transformation), Phoenix Calamity Rebirth and One Thought, Hundred Flowers Bloom. Finally he reveals the Ruthless Emperor's Myriad Changes Holy Technique, exposing himself as the Ruthless heir. Ye Fan counters with an evolution of his Battle Holy Technique and Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin and defeats him. Hua Yunfei says Ye Fan has guessed only half the truth, then escapes the holy-land experts, including Immortal Platform masters, swearing to kill Ye Fan next time.

cultivation: Bystanders infer that Hua Yunfei is at Dragon Transformation ('dia seharusnya berada di Alam Transformasi Naga'), the first of the young generation to get there; this isn't confirmed.
